question: Which fast food restaurant can I find inside 170 kilometers on the way to Cassidy Farm Conservation Land, Millis, MA from Old Colony House, Newport, RI?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.313057 41.490332)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.362131 42.184482)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.313057 41.490332)',4326)::geography, 170000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.313057 41.490332)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);

answers.poi_name: Littleton Sub Shoppe & Pub on the Common

poi.description: Location of the Rhode Island State House, 1776-1900

[4].display_name: Cassidy Farm Conservation Land, Millis, MA
